origin: Manually constructed SQL; not captured from a real model response.

cases.name: INNER JOIN, WHERE and ungrouped aggregate
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings' AND o.status = 'completed'

cases.name: LEFT JOIN with additional status condition in ON
cases.reason: ON must be one declared FK equality, not AND
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings'

cases.name: Conditional SUM using CASE
cases.reason: CASE expressions are outside the allowlist
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2) ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings'

cases.name: SUM with FILTER
cases.reason: Aggregate FILTER is not an allowed call property
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'completed'), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings'

cases.name: CTE wrapping the aggregate
cases.reason: WITH is outside the supported single SELECT form
cases.sql: WITH spending AS (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings' AND o.status = 'completed') SELECT total_spent_sek FROM spending

cases.name: Scalar subquery with zero fallback
cases.reason: Top-level FROM is required and subqueries are unsupported
cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)), 0), 2) AS total_spent_sek FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings' AND o.status = 'completed'), 0.00) AS total_spent_sek
